description: Arrange the steps to build an AI/BI Dashboard in the correct order.
instructions: An AI/BI Dashboard starts with datasets, adds relationships, then widgets, then AI features. Pattern: source data -> dataset -> relationships -> widgets -> parameters -> Genie panel -> AI insights.

blocks.code: Create a Dashboard Dataset by binding a Gold table (or saved SQL query) to the dashboard
blocks.label: Create Dataset

blocks.code: Declare Dataset Relationships -- e.g., orders.customer_id = customers.id -- for cross-filtering
blocks.label: Add Dataset Relationships

blocks.code: Add widgets: KPI cards, bar charts, line charts, tables, all bound to datasets
blocks.label: Add Widgets

blocks.code: Add Parameters: date range, region dropdown, product category -- and bind them to widget filters
blocks.label: Add Parameters / Filters

blocks.code: Add a Genie Panel widget, bind it to a configured Genie Space for in-dashboard NL Q&A
blocks.label: Add Genie Panel

blocks.code: Enable AI Insights on key charts, pick a foundation model, write context for the AI summary
blocks.label: Enable AI Insights

blocks.code: Configure scheduled refresh for the underlying datasets (every 1 hour during business hours)
blocks.label: Schedule Refresh

hints: Datasets are the typed view of data -- widgets can't exist without them
Relationships are declared up-front so cross-filtering works across widgets from day one
Widgets are the visualizations -- you can add as many as you want after datasets exist
Parameters turn a static dashboard into an interactive one
The Genie Panel is just another widget, but it hosts a Genie Space
AI Insights are configured per-widget, picking a model and context
Scheduled refresh keeps the data fresh -- required for any production dashboard
learnings: Datasets are the foundation; widgets can't exist without them
Dataset Relationships enable cross-filtering across widgets
Genie Panel is a widget, but it hosts a Genie Space
AI Insights are per-widget LLM-generated summaries
Scheduled refresh is required for any production dashboard
